title: Prime Minister highlights India’s Role in Global AI Revolution at AI Impact Summit in ANI Interview
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister highlights India’s Role in Global AI Revolution at AI Impact Summit in ANI Interview Posted On:
                18 FEB 2026 9:51AM by PIB Delhi As India hosts the prestigious AI Impact Summit in Delhi, Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared his vision on the transformative potential of Artificial Intelligence and India’s pivotal role in shaping the global AI revolution. In an exclusive interview with ANI, the Prime Minister underscored India’s unique position as a hub of innovation, talent, and ethical leadership in the AI era. In a post on X, Shri Modi wrote: “As India hosts the AI Impact Summit in Delhi, I’ve shared my thoughts on the transformative potential of AI, the role India can play in the AI revolution and more in this interview with ANI.” As India hosts the AI Impact Summit in Delhi, I’ve shared my thoughts on the transformative potential of AI, the role India can play in the AI revolution and more in this interview with ANI. https://t.co/0rYOGdm1AX — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) February 18, 2026 *** MJPS/SR (Release ID: 2229433) Visitor Counter : 77 Read this release in: Gujarati Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister highlights India’s Role in Global AI Revolution at AI Impact Summit in ANI Interview Posted On:

title: PM shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of complete and scientifically grounded knowledge
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office PM shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of complete and scientifically grounded knowledge Posted On:
                18 FEB 2026 9:47AM by PIB Delhi Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of complete and scientifically grounded knowledge. Such a complete true wisdom leads an individual to fullness, Clarity and the supreme realisation of truth. The PM quoted an ancient Sanskrit verse on X: “ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः। यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते।।” ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः। यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते।। pic.twitter.com/049Uzejn2H — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) February 18, 2026 *** MJPS/SR (Release ID: 2229432) Visitor Counter : 48 Read this release in: Gujarati Prime Minister's Office PM shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the importance of complete and scientifically grounded knowledge Posted On:
